name: Pneumo-AI
description: An end-to-end deep learning application for chest X-ray classification. Classifies X-rays as NORMAL or PNEUMONIA using a CNN approach with VGG19 transfer learning. Provides an interactive Streamlit interface with predictions, confidence scores, and visual analytics.
metric: ~91% test accuracy (project/test result — not a clinically validated diagnostic system)
technicalTakeaway: Transfer learning with VGG19 significantly reduces training time and data requirements by leveraging pre-trained ImageNet feature extractors, allowing effective classification from a smaller medical dataset.
disclaimer: This is a machine learning project for demonstrating techniques. It is not a clinically validated diagnostic tool.
